From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — security review kickoff & next steps

Hi Jamie — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary
- Demo focused on inference throughput for patient-facing summaries and embedding-based search for clinical notes.
- Key success criteria: sub-350ms median latency for 256-token responses, predictable monthly spend, and data isolation for PHI.

Stakeholders I heard on the call (please confirm / add):
- Economic buyer: Samir Patel, CFO (contract/price)
- Security lead (technical): Alex Moore, Senior Security Engineer
- Procurement / legal: procurement@orchardhealth.com

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Could you confirm the final stakeholder list and the procurement timeline?
2) I’m attaching our security pack and the intake questionnaire — can Alex or the security team review and return the questionnaire before the kickoff? (Attachment: RI_Security_Pack.pdf)
3) Proposed security kickoff window: Thu 24 Jun 09:00–10:00 PDT or Fri 25 Jun 11:00–12:00 PDT. Which works best?

Systems we think will be in scope (please confirm): EHR integration (FHIR endpoints), S3 object storage for attachments, and the customer-facing web app. If there are more systems (e.g., analytics cluster, ETL pipelines), please list them so we can scope properly.

I’ve CC’d Samir for the procurement timeline. Once we have the stakeholder contacts and completed questionnaire, I’ll loop in our security lead (Neha) and solutions engineer (Sean) for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 00:03:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Intro + demo — security review kickoff & next steps (internal)

Marissa / Sean — quick internal note before the kickoff:

Suggested intake checklist / scope clarifications to surface on the call:
1) Confirm whether PII/PHI will be sent to Redwood’s hosted API or routed via private deployment (customer-managed VPC). This determines encryption and logging scope.
2) Confirm the S3 KMS ownership model — customer-managed keys vs. Redwood-managed.
3) EHR integration details — are we getting direct API keys or a proxy service?
4) Data retention expectations and purge windows for clinical data.
5) Any regulated categories (e.g., behavioral health, minors) that would change scoping.

Artifacts to request proactively:
- Completed questionnaire (docx)
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted summary ok)
- Network / data-flow diagram
- List of AWS account IDs + IAM contact

Draft timeline for review: 3 business days initial questionnaire assessment, 5–7 business days to validate artifacts + follow-ups. If procurement needs the SOC2 / attestation for legal review, we can provide redacted versions quickly.

I’ll join the kickoff at 09:00 PDT and will bring a checklist to capture answers live.

-Neha
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Jamie
